snippet.title: Herald of the Mists Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2972310/Herald_of_the_Mists/
Website: https://fromniki.com/
Itch: https://nikiintheship.itch.io/herald-of-the-mists

Herald of the Mists is a narrative-driven RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Step into the role of the Queen's Herald and traverse a mist-shrouded realm to uncover the fate of her lost army. Will your choices uphold loyalty, or lead you down a path of betrayal?

Release Date: Coming Soon!
Platforms: PC (and hopefully, Mac and Linux)
